scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @commitloop/api && npm run lint -w @commitloop/web
scripts.format: npm run format -w @commitloop/api && npm run format -w @commitloop/web
scripts.format:write: npm run format:write -w @commitloop/api && npm run format:write -w @commitloop/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @commitloop/api && npm run typecheck -w @commitloop/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @commitloop/api && npm run test -w @commitloop/web
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w @commitloop/api && npm run test:coverage -w @commitloop/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @commitloop/api && npm run build -w @commitloop/web
scripts.screenshots:capture: npm run db:migrate:deploy -w @commitloop/api && NODE_PATH=api/node_modules tsx scripts/screenshot/capture.ts
scripts.ci: npm run arch:check && npm run content:check && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:coverage && npm run build
